profile.name: Qingxiao
profile.review:
Qingxiao is a 5-star Aero Sword DPS character who plays into the Tune Strain archetype and mostly fights in mid-air, which makes her very reminiscent of the other Tune Strain DPS, Luuk Herssen, in that sense. Not only that, they share teammates and have a similar meta position, so they are overall quite easy to compare to each other. However, their playstyles differ drastically, so let’s cover her kit in more depth:

Rotation & Goals

Qingxiao’s rotation goal is to enter her “Ephemeral Transcendence” state to cast a special Heavy Attack called Heaven’s Reckoning that deals a ton of damage. Her main damage-dealing moves are her Ultimate, Heaven’s Reckoning, her base form Heavy Attack that allows her to enter her enhanced state, as well as her Outro. The idea is to chain those as quickly together as possible to complete a rotation.

To do this, Basic Attacks will mostly be used, as well as a Skill called Severing Note: Judgement. The overwhelming majority of her rotation following an Intro can be simply completed by holding the Basic Attack down - you only change this up two times to cast her Skill and her Ultimate. That’s all. Her gameplay doesn’t get easier than this.

Other Key Mechanics

Qingxiao’s main mechanic is Tune Strain. Whenever she deals damage to an enemy once, she applies 1 stack of Tune Strain, which is converted into extra total damage to that target based on the amount of stacks when Tune Break Skills are cast. Having teammates that can apply extra stacks and cause faster Tune Break Skill casts to actually benefit from the stacks of Tune Strain applied on the enemy will prove key to increasing her overall damage output, particularly considering her Mindlock mechanic that amplifies damage of the overwhelming majority of her attacks based on the amount of Tune Strain applied on targets (7% for the first 7 stacks, 2% for the next 8, for a total of 65% possible DMG amplification).

Additionally, she gains Interruption Immunity and 60% DMG taken reduction for 1 attack after her Intro or her base Heavy Attack, inflicts additional Mindlock on every base Heavy Attack (3 stacks) and when other characters apply Tune Strain (1 stack), and can apply Mindlock stats in multi-wave content. 

Lastly, in terms of Quickswap restrictions, Qingxiao should be free to build her Forte resources to cast her initial Stringblade Heavy Attack before entering her Enhanced State, at which point the enhancements on her Heaven’s Reckoning Heavy Attack (extremely significant damage increases) get removed if you swap, so switching characters upon entering her enhanced state is discouraged. So building up to the initial Heavy Attack quicker by pre-building Forte resources is as optimized as you can go.

Meta Position & Conclusion

Overall, Qingxiao is at the top of the single-target metagame on her release, and it seems her Denia+Mornye team, which is her on-release best in slot, is there to stay as her intended best team. This means Qingxiao and Luuk share ideal teammates, so you have to privilege one or the other. And it’s a no-brainer who to pick if you have a Tune Strain team - Qingxiao’s base damage is simply higher, so she’s a stronger character overall. In the Aero department however, Luuk has been known to face issues in Whimpering Wastes and he shares a playstyle with Qingxiao, being mid-air combat and Tune Strain. Sigrika on the other hand, Qingxiao’s rival in the Aero Main DPS department, has some of the best results of any DPS in Whimpering Wastes as of Qingxiao’s release. This calls into question Qingxiao’s value across endgame modes, although she remains generally more than usable in Whimpering Wastes and has higher performance in single-target modes like ToA and Matrix overall.

Additionally, Qingxiao has a pretty significant reliance on either owning Denia and Mornye together specifically (trying to use Denia without Mornye results in major team DPS drop-offs, so there are no alternatives), or owning Lynae (at which point you can make do with ideally Mornye, but Ciaccona and Shorekeeper are fine enough alternatives as well). This, paired with a decent desire for her Signature weapon, makes Qingxiao quite the expensive character to get up and running. 

In conclusion, Qingxiao is an extremely strong pick provided you have enough invested in her and her team. While she does face some subpar performance in multi-wave content compared to some of her peers, she is not hindered too hard and still manages to perform enough to clear easily with Denia’s help for grouping in Whimpering Wastes, for example. She is without a doubt up to par in terms of damage ceiling with her late-3.x version peers and is hence one of the best DPS characters currently.
profile.pros:
• High single-target and AoE damage output, up to par with the rest of modern 3.x characters;

  • Has the ability to chase down airborne enemies with relative ease - rotation can stay consistent across a wide variety of boss encounters;

  • Easiest DPS rotation in the game’s history - just hold left click for the majority of the time; the rotation practically completes itself.
profile.cons:
• One of the more restrictive modern characters when it comes to teambuilding. Needs either Denia+Mornye specifically, or Lynae + a strong premium support. Otherwise, will fall behind significantly compared to all modern DPS characters in the game;

  • Low sequence value compared to modern standards; for comparison purposes, sequence nodes give lower increases than Carlotta across the board;

  • “Here at Wuthering Waves, we strive to deliver an interactive gameplay experience to all players.”

profile.rotations:
Rotation & Gameplay

Qingxiao is likely the simplest Main DPS character to pilot in the history of the game: inputs-wise, you only need to hold Basic Attack for a while, press Skill, hold Basic Attack again for a while, press Ultimate, Echo and Outro. That’s it. Transcripted into proper ability names, the whole combo looks like this:

Echo Timing

Ideally used right before her Outro after her Ultimate (Swap Cancel it to optimize rotation time).

Standard Rotation

  • Intro

  • Heavy: Stringblade Mid-air 1

  • Heavy: Stringblade Mid-air 2

  • Heavy: Stringblade Mid-air 3

  • Heavy: Stringblade Basic 3

  • Heavy: Stringblade Basic 4

  • Skill: Judgement

  • Heavy: Stringblade

  • Heavy: Transcendence 1

  • Heavy: Transcendence 2

  • Heavy: Transcendence 3

  • Heavy: Transcendence 4

  • Heavy: Heaven's Reckoning

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

Overall, the rotation executes itself by holding left click for the overwhelming majority of it, so it’s near-impossible to mess up. Clicking without holding on some of her abilities towards the end of her rotation is, however, recommended in multi-wave content to not use her Heavy: Heaven’s Reckoning without enemies to take its damage.

Additional Tips & Tricks

It’s possible to build up Forte resources to work towards Heavy: Stringblade before her Intro in more quickswap-friendly compositions; however, Qingxiao doesn’t ideally play in team compositions with a lot of quickswap flexibility. This may result in minimal rotation time savings, or fast Opener rotations that allow you to cast 5 fully buffed Ultimates in 2 minutes. Additionally, depending on your weapon choice and combat length, you may use her Ultimate later or earlier in her rotation at your discretion. Keep in mind it’s used at the latest point possible in the above example because you get to stack up her Signature Weapon’s passive to the max before unleashing it.

skills.name: Strings to Steel
skills.description:
Basic Attack - Stringblade

  • Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

  • Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance.

  • Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade

  • When Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available.

  • Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG.

  • Casting this skill consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and sends Qingxiao into the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade

  • Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

  • This skill is in Drawn Stance.

  • After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

  • While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Plunging Attack

  • While in the Sword Flight state, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack.

  • Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.

  • While out of the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade

  • Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

  • This skill is in Drawn Stance.

  • Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Sword Glide

  • While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.

skills.name: Severing Note
skills.description:
Severing Note: Judgement

  • Deal Aero DMG. During this skill, gain 45 points of Qin Heart.

  • While not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Severing Note: Ascendant

  • While casting Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, or Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill is replaced by Severing Note: Ascendant.

  • Deal Aero DMG.

  • This skill is in Drawn Stance.

skills.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
skills.description:
Deal Aero DMG.

skills.name: Formless Heart Sword
skills.description:
Ephemeral Transcendence

  • While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence

  • Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

  • Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.

  • Can be cast in mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence

  • Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

  • Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.

  • Can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence

  • When Heart Sword Intent is full, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available. Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill, dealing Aero DMG.

  • Casting this skill consumes all Heart Sword Intent and ends the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mindlock

  • Mindlock stacks up to 15 times.

  • Each time when a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, inflict 1 stack of Mindlock on the target.

  • For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.

    • Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity

  • Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heaven's Clarity.

  • When Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance moves deal damage, the rates at which Qin Heart/Sword Cadence are obtained increase by 100%.

  • When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 stacks of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.

  • Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward

  • Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 stack of Swordlight Ward.

  • Swordlight Ward stacks up to 1 time. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Sword Flight

  • While in the Sword Flight state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.

  • Moving in Sword Flight continuously consumes Flight Qi.

  • Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the Sword Flight state:

    • Sword Dodge, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.

  • Exit the Sword Flight state by

    • Casting Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 or Plunging Attack.

    • Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.

    • Returning to the ground.

    • Switching to another Resonator.

    • Depleting all Flight Qi.

Sword Step

  • While in the Sword Flight state, hold Jump to leap up and dash forward a short distance.

  • Sword Step can only be cast once during Sword Flight.

Qin Heart

  • Can hold up to 100 points.

  • Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.

  • Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Sword Cadence

  • Can hold up to 100 points.

  • Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.

  • Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Heart Sword Intent

  • Can hold up to 100 points.

  • Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

skills.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
skills.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stack of Gathered Mind.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:

  • If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.

  • If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.

Gathered Mind

  • After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 time on the same target.

  • When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 time on the same target.

  • When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.

  • Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

skills.name: To Know, To Banish
skills.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.

  • Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stack of Mindlock on the target.

skills.name: Tonality Shift
skills.description:
Deal Aero DMG. Upon casting, gain 30 points of Sword Cadence and gain Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime

  • Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants 30 points of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.

skills.name: Draw and Sunder
skills.description:
Qingxiao inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.

Qingxiao can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.

Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by 0.12%. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.

Additionally, when the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Qingxiao can cast Tune Break on it. While on the ground and not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Tune Break to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Camellya's Signature grants some Basic ATK DMG bonus that Qingxiao uses to an extent, but otherwise it's not an ideal replacement to her own Signature weapon. Decent alternative.

Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Qingxiao, who does not benefit from this weapon's Glacio Chafe-related effects.

Best permanent weapon option, provides Qingxiao with good Base ATK and CRIT Rate to work with alongside one less Energy Regen roll needed thanks to its secondary stat and some extra ATK% from casting a Skill once. Not ideal compared to her Signature though.
Gives CRIT DMG instead of CRIT Rate as part of its main stats which is not favoured on Qingxiao, also gives Skill DMG which is essentially useless on Qingxiao. Not recommended over any other 5-star.

Best 4-star weapon option, this Battle Pass exclusive provides CRIT Rate by default, and some ATK and Liberation DMG Bonus when casting Ultimate. Due to a much lower Base ATK than any 5-star weapon, it's not favoured over other options, but still is the best 4-star choice even if it's not recommended.

Best permanently available, no-gacha option. Simple ATK stat-stick for Qingxiao. Not recommended in general, at best use temporarily before moving on to the much stronger Signature weapon.

echoes.Comment: Simple 20% CRIT DMG increase compared to the standard Aero DMG set Sierra Gale. Provides the same 40% total Aero DMG on the 5-piece alongside 20% CRIT DMG on the condition that Tune Strain can be applied - a condition Qingxiao instantly and easily fulfills.
echoes.Echo_1_Comment: Provides 20% Aero DMG in total to the equipped character in the Main Slot. Transform Echo easily used at the end of Qingxiao's rotation and swap cancelled that provides the best stats Qingxiao can receive on her Signature Echo set.

skillPriority.Comments: Intro and Skill can be skipped when levelling to save on resources at a minimal damage loss.

teams.Name: Best Team
teams.Comments: Any teammate alternatives are not recommended to use, as with Denia, not running Mornye suffers very significant team damage losses.

teams.Name: Lynae Team
teams.Comments: Teammate alternatives don't suffer as significant drop-offs as with Denia, hence why they are suggested here separately.

synergies.Comment: Qingxiao requires a Tune Strain Hybrid buffer to function at her best. If Mornye is accessible, Denia is the strongest to use as together they provide the best array of buffs possible for her. Otherwise, Lynae is a perfectly fine alternative ideally with Mornye as she also sports lots of generalist buffs and Tune Strain application, but will usually work better with alternative Support options such as Ciaccona and Shorekeeper as her buffs are less specialized.

Qingxiao's ideal Support option is evidently the only designated Tune Strain-related Support option Mornye, as she causes more Tune Strain to be applied quicker and provides lots of buffs for characters who interact with the mechanic. However, if Lynae is the Hybrid character that supports Qingxiao, she works best with Mornye but also makes good use of alternative Supports like Ciaccona and Shorekeeper, only having to deal with minimal team damage losses if Mornye is inaccessible/has to be replaced.
